turns.replyTail:
NG IS DELIVERY?
It depends on the shipping option and destination. For U.S. ORDERS, our published estimates are 4–6 BUSINESS DAYS FOR STANDARD and 2 BUSINESS DAYS FOR PRIORITY; those estimates include fulfillment, so they aren’t additional time after the order ships. International delivery can take approximately 8–25 BUSINESS DAYS, including time in customs.
